name: Major Samuelson
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Major Samuelson commands the city guard and its personnel. The high-ranking veteran officer serves in the throne room and once mentored Lieutenant Farren Orinelle.

sections.title: A Pillar of Stormwind's Guard
sections.body: Before Stormwind's royal court, Major Samuelson leads the Stormwind City Guard. He oversees officer postings and military orders across the realm. He mentored Lieutenant Farren Orinelle, who serves at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. When junior commanders struggle or seek transfer from distant frontier garrisons, their requests and official reports travel across the kingdom to Samuelson's desk in the capital.

aliases: who is the major in keep
faq.answer: Major Samuelson is a Stormwind City Guard officer stationed in the throne room of Stormwind Keep. As an administrative commander, he oversees officer deployments and personnel.

faq.q: Where can Major Samuelson be found?
faq.answer: Major Samuelson stands in the throne room of Stormwind Keep, inside Stormwind City, near the boy-king Anduin Wrynn and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.

faq.q: What is his connection to Southshore?
faq.answer: Major Samuelson mentored Lieutenant Farren Orinelle, stationed at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Orinelle seeks reassignment from his stressful northern post through Samuelson.

faq.q: Why do adventurers seek him out?
faq.answer: Adventurers traveling from the northern front in Hillsbrad bring Lieutenant Farren Orinelle's official reassignment request to Major Samuelson in Stormwind Keep.

angles.text: Major Samuelson serves in the royal throne room and directs Stormwind's military personnel across contested lands such as Hillsbrad.
